5147-7084-8337.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat.

1879-2105-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1879-2105-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2105-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2226-4713-5921.easyPrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control three or more artifacts.
2226-4713-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4713-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lumengrid Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Lumengrid Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5223-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

585-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
585-4881-6909-8199.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Carnage to become a Kithkin until end of turn
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

5641-5805-6854.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5641-5805-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-4365-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-3480.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4644-5840-7791.description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding at least {C}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Nantuko Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Nantuko Elder.
Repeat.

215-6478-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-7730.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1399-2404-4657-7775.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
1399-2404-4657-7775.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Formidable Speaker.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

647-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
647-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
647-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

338-1874-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1874-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-4302-4875.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2511-3175-3605-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-2203-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1753-2203-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

317-3200-5660.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Urza's Bauble ability.
Repeat.

1680-3129-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1921-2034-2059.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Village Bell-Ringer token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Village Bell-Ringer token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

3440-3967-4867-6809.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice and Scion of Opulence triggers once.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 3.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5670-6273-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6273-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1371-2942-3432-6500.easyPrerequisites:
There is a land on the battlefield.
Each opponent has 60 or less life.
1371-2942-3432-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
1371-2942-3432-6500.description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 60 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to Fiery Emancipation.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Star of Extinction until each opponent loses the game.
1371-2942-3432-6500.notes: If an opponent survives the loop, you will lose the game if you have 180 or less life once your own Star of Extinction resolves.

7-586-5147-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-586-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

792-1263-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {1}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2557-3693-4772-5270.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Samwise triggers, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Walking Ballista to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1926-2034-2124.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Knight" chosen with Species Specialist.
1926-2034-2124.description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
When the Knight dies, Species Specialist triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

38-678.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
Repeat.

2335-2744-2760.notablePrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
Barrenton Medic does not have more than two -1/-1 counters on it.
2335-2744-2760.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it, preventing the next one damage done to it this turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Barrenton Medic ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

262-1486-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Elemental Mastery attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
262-1486-4222.description:
Activate Magda by tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Magda's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

1000-2103-2493-3791.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2103-2493-3791.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Hordeling Outburst by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Capture of Jingzhou, and Hordeling Outburst to your hand.
Repeat.

65-615-717-2628-4607.description:
Activate Smoldering Crater's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Smoldering Crater, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Smoldering Crater trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Cartographer.
Cartographer enters the battlefield, returning Smoldering Crater from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
